title: Rustic
text: Rustic. This snowman wreath is rustic looking. It's basically 2 round wreaths connected together. The quality is okay, but it does seem a bit flimsy as far as their connection. There's a battery operated light included that's not attached, so you have to figure out how you would hang that on if you want to use it. Plus batteries are not included. Overall, it's fine, but it's just not my style.
